summary: Implemented `in` membership for Namespace and ClosedNamespace in rdflib/namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()), using node-type-aware equality; _RDFNamespace inherits it. _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). Added tests to NamespacePrefixTest in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, RDFS closed positive/negative and non-URIRef negatives, RDF closed positive and container-property negative, and SH prefix positive. Nothing was committed. Tests and doctests were NOT run, per instructions; the changes are verified by reading only.
